edges.reason: msg.sender is assigned to the owner state variable in the Owned constructor.
msg.sender decides whose balance is debited by transfer.
transfer reads and writes balances[msg.sender].
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner for transferOwnership.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner.
msg.sender authorises the allowance written by approveAndCall.
onlyOwner modifier guards transferAnyERC20Token.
transfer calls safeSub on the sender balance.
transfer calls safeAdd on the recipient balance.
transfer mutates the balances mapping.
approve writes into the allowed mapping.
transferFrom calls safeSub for balance and allowance deduction.

transferFrom mutates the allowed mapping.

msg.sender is forwarded as the from argument of the external receiveApproval call.

transferOwnership writes the newOwner state variable.

safeAdd performs the raw addition that can overflow before the require check.
safeSub performs the raw subtraction guarded only by require(b <= a).
safeMul performs the raw multiplication that can overflow before the require check.
safeMul calls safeDiv as part of its overflow verification.
